Landing.title: Shopylist
Landing.tagline: One shopping list for the whole household
Landing.lead: Add items on your phone, tick them off in the store, share the list with family or friends in one click. Free, no ads.
Landing.feature1Text: Everyone with access sees the same list. Someone adds milk at home, you see it in the store.
Landing.feature2Text: Tap an item to mark it as bought. Bought items drop to the bottom, the rest stays in your order.
Landing.feature3Text: One tap groups items by aisle: produce, bakery, dairy, meat, frozen, drinks, household.
Landing.feature4Text: Invite by email for editing, or turn on a public link for viewing or editing without an account.
Landing.step1: Sign in with your Google account. No new password.
Landing.step2: Create a list and add items, on the phone or on the computer.
Landing.step3: Share it with the people you shop with and go shopping.
Landing.ctaText: Sign in and create your first list in under a minute.
